items.title: Google Privacy Update Lets Connected Apps Shape AI Mode Ads
items.excerpt: Google updated its privacy policy so insights from connected Gmail, Photos and Drive apps can shape the ads shown in AI Mode, with implications for how Google Ads campaigns are targeted.

history_match.title: Google begins testing ads in AI Mode for users with Personal Intelligence enabled

items.title: Shopify Moves AI Agent Knowledge Base Into Merchant Admin
items.excerpt: Shopify's knowledge base that feeds store facts to AI shopping agents now lives in the merchant admin; policies and contact details publish by default and some app users must re-add their facts.

history_match.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents

items.title: ChatGPT Rarely Named Some Brands Even When Sources Mentioned Them
items.excerpt: New comparison-prompt data from Graphite shows brands that logged-out ChatGPT rarely names without search also appear less when it searches, even when cited pages mention them.

items.title: Only 2 of 3,379 AI-flagged Meta ad files disclosed AI use, Resemble AI finds
items.excerpt: One in 11 Facebook and Instagram ad files from 509 brands carried AI-generated media, 70% built to look real, yet only 2 of 3,379 flagged files disclosed AI use, while New York and EU labelling rules already apply to ads.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO filing shows $16.3bn of revenue and no plan to sell ads
items.excerpt: Anthropic's S-1 shows $16.3bn of first-half revenue and no advertising model for Claude, setting it apart from ChatGPT's ad push.

items.title: Kochava's StationOne now routes simple AI tasks to cheaper models
items.excerpt: Kochava's StationOne AI workspace for marketers now routes simple tasks to cheaper models, lets admins set token or dollar budgets per user and team, and can run models locally.

items.title: Anthropic's ad bill is soaring, according to IPO filing
items.excerpt: Anthropic's S-1 filing shows an ad-free AI company with a fast-growing advertising bill as it markets Claude against rivals.

items.title: Inside indie agencies' DSP gripes and the rise of agentic media buying
items.excerpt: Independent agencies are pushing back on costly DSP fees as AI agents threaten to reshape how media is bought and who controls ad dollars.

history_match.title: As agencies push agentic media future, execs work to ward off client rogue fears

items.title: The Daily Mail tests GEO with brands ahead of AI visibility product
items.excerpt: The Daily Mail is running around a dozen generative-engine-optimization tests with brands before turning its AI visibility offering into a sellable product next year.

items.title: This Startup Makes Sure That AI Tools Aren't Out Of Reach For SMBs
items.excerpt: AI growth platform Pie aims to give smaller businesses affordable access to AI marketing and advertising tools usually reserved for larger advertisers.

items.title: From Puppies To Programmatic To AI Agents
items.excerpt: Kovva COO Tanja Mimica on whether media buyers will trust AI agents to take over programmatic busywork, and the guardrails they need.

items.title: Google Sells Itself As A Commerce 'Matchmaker,' Not A Retailer
items.excerpt: As AI agents reshape product discovery, Google pitches its Universal Commerce Protocol and newly launched Universal Cart in Gemini and Search as a matchmaker for brands, leaving fulfillment to retailers.

history_match.title: Google's Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US

items.title: 커머스 AI '인덴트M' 공개…“K브랜드 72개국 진출 지원”
items.excerpt: 인덴트코퍼레이션이 72개국에서 인플루언서 마케팅 기획과 실행을 대신 수행하는 AI 에이전트 '인덴트M'을 공개했다.

items.title: Fake AI Review Ads Disguised as Testimonials Spreading Online
items.excerpt: A significant number of ordinary-consumer review ads on YouTube turn out to be fabricated with AI, raising deceptive-advertising concerns in Korea. (off-list: no on-list Korean outlet covered it)
